answer: Island Ledger Divergence: each agent maintains a private, continually updated event island and publishes only a digest. Any agent claiming two identities must keep both ledgers consistent under random cross-checks; a hidden duplicate eventually shows a nadir of matching digests, exposing the clone. Recovering requires separately sourcing records, so per-identity cost doubles. Every identity also carries a lantern token whose signed beacon must appear in the ledger, making silent copies detectable.
